column2: and you won't draw a card
column3: Contradicts the card's Oracle text in part (template error; policy ruling-contradicting-oracle-gives-way, decided by the user Nov 5): the 2022-10-07 ruling has 'you' draw ('you won't draw a card', 'you'll draw a card'), where the card has the destroyed artifact's controller draw ('Whenever this creature attacks, destroy up to one target artifact. If an artifact is destroyed this way, its controller draws a card.'). The Warhammer 40,000 Commander Release Notes (2022-09-19; ormos mirror, Wayback capture 2022-09-19) print the same ruling under the same card text, so the data copied its source faithfully. Likely origin: the template of Noxious Gearhulk's ruling (2016-09-20) 'If the target creature has indestructible, it isn't destroyed this way and you won't gain life. If it is destroyed but put into a zone other than a graveyard, you'll gain life.', right for a card whose controller gains the life; Rampage of the Clans' ruling on the same template (2019-01-25) says 'its controller'. The rest of the ruling (an indestructible artifact isn't destroyed this way and no card is drawn; one destroyed but put into another zone still has a card drawn) agrees with the card and stays cited (tests/rulings/r_p060_misc.rs); logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md
